label: IKS|Lab listening room, Institute of Communication Systems, RWTH Aachen University
note: ITU-R BS.1116-3 room, floor 35 m2, T60 about 0.25 s (documentation.pdf); 36 Neumann KH120D: 31 at 1.6 m from the room centre (grid point 000) on three levels, and 5 on the ceiling, loudspeaker 32 overhead at 1.3 m and 33-36 on a 1.1 m circle around it at 1.7 m (the Zenodo record's correction; documentation.pdf Table 1 and the files' info struct give 1.6 m and 1.9 m); source speaker_<n> is loudspeaker n of Table 1; receiver IR_<xyz> is the em64 grid index (x, y in -2..2 times 50 cm, z -1, 0, 1 = 45, 115, 185 cm above the floor; no corner points); positions are not read. RIRDB measures T30 0.18 s at 500 Hz-1 kHz and 0.24 s broadband; the stated T60 of about 0.25 s is the broadband average. The lab's background noise holds lines at 59-94 Hz, which mark 36 IRs as tonal (grade C) without changing their decay values.
